clue.text: Thankful for a quantity of coal?

definitions.meaning: feeling or showing thanks for a kindness
playfully, as much coal as a fireplace's grate will hold

explanation.definitionFit: Thankful is a plain synonym; the second sense is a pun on how much a fire basket holds.

clue.text: Middle Eastern artist first, one of five, had food served in a small dish

definitions.text: food served in a small dish

indicators.note: first says the artist's letters come at the front, before the Middle Eastern ones

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is the usual crossword artist
ME is the abbreviation for Middle East or Middle Eastern
a quin is one of quintuplets, five babies born together

explanation.surface: A Middle Eastern painter, one of quintuplets, ate a little dish of food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' puts RA ahead of ME. The word is the French spelling of ramekin, which names both the little baking dish and the cheese dish baked in it.
explanation.definitionFit: A ramekin, also spelt this way, is a cheese dish baked and served in an individual pot.

clue.text: Out-and-out British revolutionary was high-spirited

parts.note: thorough means complete, out-and-out
a red is a revolutionary communist

explanation.surface: A complete British rebel was full of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: A pedigree racehorse is spirited and lively, so the word describes a high-mettled, well-bred character.

clue.text: Little Alfred turned to study the bird

indicators.note: turned says the short name is rotated, its last letter brought round to the front

parts.note: Alf is a short form of the name Alfred
to con is to study or learn by heart

explanation.surface: Young Alfred went off to study ornithology.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned' here means the short name is rotated, its last letter coming to the front, not reversed outright; 'Little' signals the shortened form of Alfred.
explanation.definitionFit: A hawk-like bird of prey trained for hunting.

clue.text: Only movement in a Scottish river

indicators.note: movement says the letters of the preceding word shift about into a new order

explanation.surface: The only current in a Highland river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lyon flows through Glen Lyon in Perthshire, Scotland, a tributary of the Tay.

clue.text: Large number taking religious education quite upset by the review

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
RI, religious instruction, stands in for religious education

indicators.note: upset says the letters of quite are knocked over into a new order

explanation.surface: A lot of RE pupils were rather put out by the review.
explanation.definitionFit: A critical essay or assessment, the same as a review.

clue.text: Two half turns in a skirt

indicators.note: Two says the half-word piece appears twice in a row
half takes just the front part of the word turns

explanation.surface: A dancer does a couple of half-pirouettes in her skirt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half' takes the front of 'turns', TU, and 'Two' doubles it.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballerina's short stiff skirt of layered net.

clue.text: Is its fruit just over a foot in length?

definitions.text: Is its fruit just over a foot in length?

parts.words: Is its fruit just over a foot in length?
parts.note: pictures a plant whose crop is footwear-sized, but the 'tree' is a wooden form slipped inside footwear to keep its shape

explanation.surface: A botanical question about a tree bearing unusually long fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A shaped block placed inside a shoe to hold its form, playfully called a tree.

clue.text: Young man about to prepare for battle on the Isle of Wight

indicators.note: about says the young man's letters go around the other piece

parts.note: a youth is a young man
to arm is to get weapons ready for fighting

explanation.surface: A lad is about to gear up for war on the island.
explanation.walkthrough: The ISLE OF WIGHT is an island off England's south coast; Yarmouth is a small port town there, not the better-known Great Yarmouth in Norfolk.
explanation.definitionFit: A small harbour town on the island's north-west coast.

clue.text: Being the doctor, I have the weapons

parts.note: 'I am' is the state of being, giving AM
MO, medical officer, is a military doctor

explanation.surface: A medical officer boasts of carrying arms.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Being the doctor, I' as 'I am MO'; 'have the' is link material before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for ammunition, the bullets and shells that weapons fire.

clue.text: Add water to restore make-up

definitions.meaning: to bring dried food back to its original state by wetting it
to rebuild something's composition or form

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers rehydrating powdered food and remaking an organisation's structure.

clue.text: Passage of radio waves in a car

definitions.meaning: sending a broadcast signal through the air
the gearbox system that carries engine power to the wheels

explanation.definitionFit: The word means broadcasting a signal and also a vehicle's gearbox.

clue.text: Seasonal?

parts.note: the question mark narrows 'seasonal' to one particular time of year, the one of falling leaves

explanation.definitionFit: Belonging to the season after summer, which is a seasonal quality in the narrowest sense.

clue.text: It's only right he likes his own company

parts.note: lone means only or sole

explanation.surface: A remark that a solitary man is quite correct to enjoy himself alone.
explanation.definitionFit: A solitary person who prefers being by themselves to mixing with others.

clue.text: Question us about one on arrival of a distant luminous body

indicators.note: about says the word us wraps around the single letter

parts.note: taken as written
A stands for one, the indefinite article
AR is the timetable abbreviation for arrival

explanation.surface: Someone asks about a single bright distant object on its appearance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts A inside US to make UAS.
explanation.definitionFit: A very remote, extremely bright galactic nucleus seen as a star-like point.

clue.text: Go forward slowly less than a foot

definitions.meaning: to edge along little by little
a unit of length, one twelfth of a foot

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means creep forward, and the noun is a twelfth of a foot.

clue.text: Alerting members all in one piece

indicators.note: members is read as re-members, the letters of the preceding word put together again in another order

explanation.surface: Raising the alarm among club members, all together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'members' is read as re-members, putting ALERTING back together in a new order.
explanation.definitionFit: Integral means whole and complete, forming a single unit.

clue.text: Poet appeared the day before

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for day
ante is Latin for before, as in ante-room

explanation.surface: A poet turned up twenty-four hours early.
explanation.walkthrough: 'appeared' is a link word between definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Dante Alighieri was the Italian poet who wrote the Divine Comedy.

clue.text: Glucose formerly could have been sorted out

indicators.note: out, after could have been, says the letters are scrambled into another order

parts.note: ex means formerly, as in ex-wife

explanation.surface: A remark that sugar might once have been graded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could have been sorted out' reads as idle speculation about sugar, but 'out' is the anagram signal and 'formerly' contributes letters to the pool.
explanation.definitionFit: Dextrose is the common chemical name for glucose found in plants and blood.

clue.text: Place ties at random

indicators.note: at random says the letters of ties fall into any order

explanation.surface: Lay neckwear down anyhow.
explanation.definitionFit: A site is a location or spot, the same as a place.

clue.text: Hold dear what could be very dear

definitions.meaning: a hoard of valuables, something costly

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means cherish, and the noun is a store of precious, costly things.

clue.text: Author axing part of an insect's body!

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A writer cutting out part of a bug's anatomy.
explanation.definitionFit: The thorax is the middle segment of an insect, between head and abdomen.

clue.text: One getting the present set

definitions.meaning: a person who is handed a gift

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a recipient of a gift and also a radio apparatus.

clue.text: Plant left in screen

indicators.note: in says the left letter goes inside the word for screen

parts.note: to cover is to screen or shield

explanation.surface: A plant hidden behind a partition.
explanation.definitionFit: A low trefoil plant of meadows, grown for fodder.

clue.text: Exclamation that is both kind and courteous

parts.note: good means kind
gracious means courteous and polite

explanation.surface: Praise for someone both kind and polite, said with feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: A cry of surprise, like 'my goodness'.

clue.text: It flows in joyous ecstasy

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the following words

explanation.surface: A stream runs through a happy rapture.
explanation.walkthrough: The run spans 'joyOUS Ecstasy'; the Ouse is one of several English rivers of that name.
explanation.definitionFit: A river is something that flows, and the Ouse is an English river.

clue.text: Clothed many a youngster

parts.note: C, a hundred in Roman numerals, stands for many
a lad is a youngster

explanation.surface: Lots of boys were dressed.
explanation.definitionFit: Clad is an old past tense of clothe, meaning dressed.

clue.text: It could spell ruin in Spain

indicators.note: could spell says the letters of ruin might be written out in a different order

explanation.surface: A remark that something might bring disaster to Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: Irun is a Spanish border town in the Basque Country; the definition simply places it in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Irun is a town in the Basque Country of northern Spain, on the French border.

clue.text: Intercept as scab is removed

indicators.note: removed says the letters of as scab is are shifted out of place into a new order

explanation.surface: A wound's crust being picked off.
explanation.definitionFit: In geometry, an intercept on the x-axis is the horizontal coordinate of a point.

clue.text: Called, during the action, mad

indicators.note: during says the call word sits inside the word for the action

parts.note: a deed is an act or action
rang means telephoned, called

explanation.surface: Someone phoned in the middle of the fighting, frantic.
explanation.walkthrough: The commas make 'during the action' look like scene-setting, but 'during' is the container signal and 'the action' is the outer word.
explanation.definitionFit: Deranged means insane, out of one's mind.
